entry.title: Accounting
entry.summary: Accounting that brings clarity and continuity — accurate records, steady oversight and stability that keeps your entire structure in order.
entry.content:
Accounting that brings clarity and continuity — accurate records, steady oversight and stability that keeps your entire structure in order.

Bookkeeping & Financial Records

  • Full bookkeeping for micro and small companies, sole traders and partnerships
  • Bookkeeping support for clients who enter their own data
  • Setting up the accounting system and workflow
  • Periodic reviews and corrections to ensure accuracy
  • Bookkeeping clearance before annual accounts
  • Ensuring records are complete, consistent and ready for annual accounts

Accounts Preparation

  • Annual accounts for micro and small companies
  • Receipts & payments or accruals accounts for charities
  • Adjusting entries and year‑end corrections
  • Ensuring alignment between accounting, tax and business decisions
  • Preparing supporting schedules and documentation
  • Reviewing the business profile (e.g., property flip, new service, new income stream) and adjusting accounting treatment accordingly

Tax Filings

  • Corporation Tax
  • VAT registration and returns
  • VAT adjustments and ongoing compliance
  • PAYE payroll and RTI submissions
  • Construction Industry Scheme deductions and reporting
  • Self‑Assessment for directors and business owners

Cost Classification & Financial Accuracy

  • Correct cost classification throughout the year
  • Ensuring expenses match the business model and tax rules
  • Identifying misclassifications and correcting them before year‑end
  • Ensuring clean, audit‑ready records

Reviews, Checks & Clarifications

  • Preparing documents for reviews, checks and clarifications
  • Ensuring accounting records match tax and compliance requirements
  • Providing explanations and evidence for HMRC or lenders
  • Ensuring financial documentation is consistent with governance and resolutions

Accounting System Choice & Support

  • Advising whether to use your own accounting setup or leave the full process with us
  • Helping clients choose the right system for their business
  • Setting up chart of accounts, workflows and controls
  • Providing ongoing support and periodic audits of client‑maintained systems

Charities & Not‑for‑Profit (Small and Medium)

  • Bookkeeping and financial records
  • Receipts & payments or accruals accounts
  • Annual accounts and supporting documentation
  • Preparing information for Charity Commission submissions
  • Bookkeeping clearance and system setup
  • Ensuring alignment with governance, tax and accounting
  • Support for trustees and small charity committees

entry.title: Compliance
entry.summary: Compliance support that protects your operations — clear structure, aligned processes and steady regulatory support that keeps your business stable.
entry.content:
Compliance support that protects your operations — clear structure, aligned processes and steady regulatory support that keeps your business stable.

Scope of Work

Governance & Corporate Structure

  • Company governance for micro and small businesses
  • Compliance for holding structures and group entities
  • PSC management and statutory registers
  • Resolutions and minutes for business decisions
  • Ensuring decisions are aligned with tax and accounting treatment
  • Director duties and decision‑making frameworks
  • Ensuring alignment between governance, tax and accounting

Companies House & Corporate Compliance

  • Maintaining statutory registers and PSC records
  • Preparing resolutions and minutes for business decisions
  • Filing statutory changes (directors, shareholders, addresses, share structure)
  • Preparing confirmation statements and supporting documents
  • Ensuring company records match real operations 
  • Reviewing company structure for compliance and risk
  • Coordinating filings across multi‑entity and holding structures
  • Ensuring Companies House documentation is consistent with governance, tax and accounting

Operational Compliance

  • Operational policies and procedures tailored to the business
  • Internal controls and workflow documentation
  • Compliance processes for day‑to‑day operations
  • Updating compliance when business activities change
  • Ensuring documentation matches real operations 

Risk & Internal Controls

  • Business‑level risk assessments
  • Identifying operational, financial and compliance risks
  • Designing proportionate internal controls
  • Ongoing monitoring of regulatory obligations
  • Practical guidance for reducing exposure to penalties and disputes

AML & Due Diligence

  • AML documentation and internal processes
  • Customer due diligence procedures 
  • AML registers and evidence files
  • Risk‑based approach for onboarding clients
  • Preparing for AML checks and audits
  • Clarifying AML requirements for specific business models

Regulatory Documentation & Reporting

  • Mandatory reporting requirements for small companies
  • Preparing compliance documentation for regulators
  • Clarifying regulatory expectations and obligations
  • Responding to compliance checks and enquiries
  • Evidence packs, explanations and structured responses

Entity Management & SPV Compliance

  • Compliance for property SPVs
  • Documentation for investors and shareholders
  • Maintaining statutory records and filings
  • Ensuring SPV alignment with tax and accounting
  • Ongoing monitoring of obligations for multi‑entity structures

Business‑Specific Obligations & Insurance Requirements

  • Identifying mandatory insurance requirements for specific business types
  • Clarifying statutory obligations for landlords, traders and service providers
  • Ensuring business activities meet minimum legal and regulatory standards
  • Preparing documentation and evidence for compliance checks
  • Aligning operational obligations with tax, accounting and governance
  • Highlighting sector‑specific risks and required internal controls

Charity Governance & Compliance (Small and Medium)

  • Governance support for trustees and committees
  • Policies, procedures and internal controls
  • Minutes, resolutions and decision‑making documentation
  • Ensuring alignment between governance, accounting and reporting
  • Preparing documentation for Charity Commission submissions
  • Risk assessments and operational compliance for small charities

entry.title: Tax
entry.summary: Tax support built around your decisions — clear guidance, precise planning and a forward view that helps you make well‑informed, profitable choices.
entry.content:
Tax support built around your decisions — clear guidance, precise planning and a forward view that helps you make well‑informed, profitable choices.

Scope of Work

Business Tax

  • Corporation Tax (CT600)
  • VAT registration and returns
  • VAT adjustments and ongoing compliance
  • CIS deductions and reporting
  • Tax implications of business changes (new activity, property flip, restructuring)
  • Monitoring thresholds and statutory deadlines
  • Preparing structured responses for HMRC enquiries and checks

Personal Tax for Business Owners

  • Self‑Assessment (SA100)
  • Income Tax planning for business owners and directors
  • Tax planning aligned with the owner’s personal tax position
  • Dividends, salary, benefits and withdrawals
  • Inheritance Tax considerations where relevant

Cross‑Border & International Tax

  • UK tax considerations for clients with income or assets abroad
  • Income or gains arising from overseas assets
  • Rental income from overseas properties
  • Capital gains on the sale of overseas assets
  • Double taxation and foreign tax credit relief
  • Clear explanations for clients with international ties

Property‑Related Taxes

  • Council Tax and Business Rates guidance for property investors
  • Tax treatment of property income and expenses
  • Tax implications of property flips and developments
  • Capital allowances and allowable costs
  • Tax alignment for SPVs and property groups

Customs, Duties & Import Taxes

  • Guidance on customs duties and import VAT
  • Classification and documentation support
  • Preparing structured explanations for HMRC
  • Ensuring correct accounting treatment of duties and import VAT
  • Support for businesses importing goods into the UK

Tax Planning & Structuring

  • Tax‑efficient structuring for micro and small companies
  • Alignment between business structure, personal tax and accounting
  • Group and holding structure tax alignment
  • Timing of income and expenses
  • Allowances, reliefs and exemptions

Ownership & Income Allocation

  • Reviewing beneficial ownership for tax purposes
  • Adjusting allocation of property income between spouses or partners
  • Preparing evidence and explanations for HMRC
  • Ensuring correct tax treatment based on actual entitlement
  • Aligning ownership structure with personal and business tax planning

entry.title: Legal
entry.summary: Legal support that protects your position — clear agreements, precise drafting, and structured, effective preparation with consistent guidance at every stage.
entry.content:
Legal support that protects your position — clear agreements, precise drafting, and structured, effective preparation with consistent guidance at every stage.

Scope of Work

Commercial & Business

  • Drafting and reviewing commercial agreements
  • Drafting service agreements
  • Preparing terms, policies and operational documents
  • Contract drafting and clause refinement
  • Reviewing client-provided documents prior to signature
  • Preparing payment demands and receivables documentation
  • Negotiating with counterparties

Security & Debt Protection

  • Preparing loan agreements and promissory notes
  • Drafting personal guarantees
  • Drafting contractual security clauses
  • Preparing equitable charges (non‑registered security)
  • Preparing notices of assignment and notices of charge
  • Drafting retention of title clauses
  • Preparing acknowledgements of debt
  • Structuring repayment plans
  • Preparing evidence and documentation for enforcement procedures

Enforcement & Charging Orders

  • Preparing applications for charging orders (post‑CCJ)
  • Drafting interim and final charging order documents
  • Preparing Land Registry documentation for court‑ordered security
  • Preparing notices to debtors and co‑owners
  • Preparing schedules of debt and evidence packs

Disputes & Court Procedure

  • Preparing pre‑action strategy
  • Drafting letters before action and responses
  • Providing procedural guidance (applications, statements, evidence, timelines)
  • Supporting litigants in person step‑by‑step
  • Drafting applications for injunctions (where appropriate)
  • Preparing bundles, schedules and supporting documents
  • Coordinating with solicitors or barristers
  • Providing enforcement support for creditors and debtors

HMRC‑Related Legal Support

  • Preparing challenges to HMRC decisions
  • Drafting structured responses to HMRC enquiries
  • Preparing evidence, explanations and supporting documents
  • Negotiating with HMRC where appropriate
  • Ensuring legal alignment with tax and accounting positions

Property Legal Support

  • Drafting residential and commercial tenancy agreements
  • Reviewing leases and identifying risks
  • Supporting landlord–tenant matters
  • Preparing notices, demands and procedural documentation
  • Coordinating with solicitors and lenders
  • Supporting property transactions (documents, checks, timelines)
